title: PlaytestInput
description:
What `playtest` plays. A number left out is the game's default
([`GameTools::playtest_defaults`]).

entrants.description:
The entrants that play, by name or by a group's name; the game's
default ones if empty.

every_stage.description: Every stage of the game, in its order, a report each.

seed.description: The first try's seed; each next try takes the next.

stage.description:
The stage, one of the game's; needed when it has several, unless
`every_stage`.

start.description: The game's own options, in the order given.

threads.description:
The threads to play on; one a core if left out. The report never
depends on it.

tries.description: How many tries of each entrant.

turns.description: The turn a try stops at if it hasn't ended.

value.description: Its value, if it takes one.
